items.text: Houthi forces in Yemen announced they targeted a Saudi oil tanker in the northern Red Sea with a ballistic missile, causing a fire. They also targeted Saudi military forces and equipment in two other areas using missiles and drones. The group emphasized they are ready to respond to any escalation of tensions.

The Trump administration intends to focus potential negotiations with the Islamic Republic on Tehran's nuclear program, not the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Tehran has linked its readiness for nuclear talks to resolving the Strait of Hormuz issue. Oman is working on a regional framework to reopen the strait, and the US has reviewed Oman's plan but has not officially supported it yet.

Mohsen Hashemi stated that during the 12-day and 40-day wars, some officials used metro stations as workplaces. He emphasized that intersection metro stations require facilities such as restrooms and emergency power. These remarks highlight the importance of preparing the metro for crisis situations.

The Omani Foreign Minister announced the postponement of the meeting between Iran and the Gulf countries scheduled for September 13 in Salalah to reach a consensus. The meeting was focused on the Strait of Hormuz and Iran and Oman's plan for safe ship passage. The US stated it will not participate in Strait of Hormuz talks and will focus negotiations on the nuclear issue.

Masoud Pezeshkian called the attack by the IRGC on three commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz reckless and irresponsible. He contacted the IRGC commander demanding accountability. The commander denied responsibility and stated that the Supreme National Security Council was unaware of the operation.
Siamak Mofidi, 17, and Soroush Enayati, 16, two detained teenagers from Takab, were released from the Tehran Correction and Rehabilitation Center on bail.

Dermot Gallagher, former Premier League referee, stated on the Hat Trick program that Esteghlal's penalty against Paykan was correctly awarded and both goals by Shahryar Moghanloo in the match between Esteghlal Khuzestan and Traktor were correctly ruled offside.

Mehdi Khaledi, a resident of Shushtar, was arrested by agents of the IRGC Intelligence Organization and transferred to an unknown location. The arrest took place on the evening of Saturday, September 12, 2026. Harana News Agency reported this incident.

John Bolton criticized Washington's approach towards the Islamic Republic as confused and contradictory. He stated that there is still a possibility of achieving the desired outcome, including regime change in Iran. These remarks were made on the social network X.

Mohammad Qaedi said the US has adopted a strategy of resource prioritization to manage tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea. Riyadh has requested three guarantees from Washington, but the Trump administration has not provided such guarantees. These guarantees include intelligence warnings, participation in attacks on Houthi positions, and a commitment to defend Saudi Arabia's critical infrastructure.

Alexander Zverev won the US Open for the first time by defeating Ben Shelton in four sets after three hours and 33 minutes. This is Zverev's second Grand Slam title after winning the French Open earlier this year. Ben Shelton failed to end the 23-year wait for American men to win the US Open.

The Oman meeting has been postponed at Saudi Arabia's request following attacks on its energy infrastructure. Saudi Arabia is concerned about stabilizing the current situation in the Strait of Hormuz. The US Energy Secretary stated that any agreement on the Strait of Hormuz without US approval is invalid.

The University of Toronto is hosting a meeting on the fourth anniversary of Mahsa Amini's death with academics and civil activists. The session will review the history of freedom struggles from the establishment of the Islamic Republic to recent protests. This report was prepared by Mahsa Mortazavi.

Barak Ravid reported that Saudi Arabia has made amendments to the proposal by Oman and the Islamic Republic regarding the Strait of Hormuz. Riyadh was concerned that the proposed text would establish a new situation unacceptable to Saudi Arabia and other Gulf Cooperation Council members. This information was cited from a Gulf countries official.

The English Premier League arbitration body confirmed that VAR made a misjudgment in approving Erling Haaland's goal. VAR should have advised the referee to review Enzo Fernandez's role in the offside position. This concerns the 60th-minute goal of Manchester City against Manchester United.

Mehdi Kharatian, a political expert affiliated with the government, mentioned the role of the Islamic Republic in activating Yemen's Houthis to attack Saudi Arabia's oil infrastructure. He said this action has caused a sharp increase in oil prices. He also commented on the destruction of an oil pipeline, saying, "Whoever did it, God bless them."

Atefeh Ramazani-Zadeh and Fatemeh Pasandideh, former players of the Iranian women's national football team, spoke in an interview with Australian television about events at the Asian Championship. These events have changed their lives forever. Additional explanations were provided by Raha Pourbakhsh in the Hat-Trick program.

Bloomberg reported that due to pressure from the Trump administration, Mohammad Eslami, Vice President and head of the Atomic Energy Organization of the Islamic Republic, was prevented from speaking at the IAEA General Conference in Vienna. A US official said that Eslami was scheduled to speak on Monday, but Austria did not agree to the UN-requested sanction waiver for his entry, and this decision was made after a US request. A lower-level representative from the Islamic Republic may speak later in the week.

Kimia Alizadeh, the Iranian taekwondo athlete for Bulgaria, won the bronze medal at the 2026 European Multisport Games in Niš, Serbia. She withdrew in the semifinals due to certain conditions. Alizadeh has competed for Bulgaria since 2024 and is a European champion and Olympic bronze medalist in Paris.

The meeting of the foreign ministers of the Gulf coastal countries in Oman has been postponed. Tasnim News Agency claimed that Saudi Arabia and Bahrain prevented the meeting, and a negative role of the UAE was also mentioned. Oman stated the postponement was to achieve consensus, and Iran confirmed this decision.

Donald Trump reacted to a report about the Islamic Republic receiving satellite images of a base in Jordan from Chinese entities by saying they are doing the same thing as the US. Trump did not directly answer whether he would raise the issue in his meeting with Xi Jinping. The Wall Street Journal reported that the Islamic Republic had received satellite images from Chinese entities before the attack on the Jordan base.

The Hana human rights organization reported that one of the Kurdistan Komala Party camps in the Zargoyzleh area was targeted by four missiles. There is no precise information about the damage or casualties from the attack. Earlier, a loud explosion was heard in Sulaymaniyah province, Iraq.

CBS News, in its "60 Minutes" program, published details about the downing of a US F-15 fighter jet in southern Isfahan and the operation by the US Army and CIA to rescue its two crew members. CENTCOM Commander Brad Cooper stated that the fighter jet was targeted on the evening of April 2nd during a mission to attack industrial facilities related to the Islamic Republic's drone and missile program, with CBS identifying a shoulder-fired missile as the cause. Over 90 US military personnel entered Iran to rescue the second crew member, who suffered fractures after his parachute was damaged; after his rescue, two US planes and helicopters were destroyed.

Javan newspaper criticized Masoud Pezeshkian's remarks about an agreement with the Emirati crown prince to leave the past behind. The editor emphasized that foreign policy is not a matter of personal emotions and Tehran should not take the lead in leaving the past. He also called for demanding positions from officials and coordination of Pezeshkian's rhetoric with other senior figures.

Bezalel Smotrich, Israel's finance minister, threatened to destroy Iran's energy infrastructure if Iran initiates military action. He said this would target both domestic consumption and export infrastructure. He also spoke about the possibility of escalating military tensions and Israel's readiness for such a scenario.

Sadegh Beigdeli stated that economic pressure and siege are effective tools used by the US against the Islamic Republic. He added that the US will not give up these tools as long as they work. He also linked current regional developments to future order and energy security.

Mizan news agency reported that 240 properties of individuals accused of crimes such as treason and collaboration with hostile governments have been seized. 143 of these properties are located in Tehran, some belonging to journalists and media activists. Additionally, 182 bank accounts of these individuals have been blocked.

Reza Shahbazi, deputy of geology at the Geological Organization, stated that land subsidence in Iran has increased from about 10,000 square kilometers in the mid-2010s to around 100,000 square kilometers in 2024. This phenomenon has expanded in provinces such as Isfahan, Kerman, Tehran, Alborz, Qazvin, Khorasan Razavi, Golestan, and northern Khuzestan. Additionally, subsidence around Lake Urmia has reached about 8,500 to 9,000 square kilometers.

Kamyar Behrang referred to Ahmad Reza Radan's remarks about arrests and armed threats against citizens. He said the government knows it cannot eliminate public dissatisfaction through executions and repression, only temporarily control protests. The Islamic Republic also knows that people will eventually win, which is why it intensifies its threatening rhetoric.

Erfan Ghaneifard analyzed the attack on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline as aimed at destabilizing an alternative oil transit route. He stated that the Islamic Republic is intensifying security pressure on Saudi Arabia through the Houthis and Shiite armed groups in Iraq.

Reza Taghipour Anvari, Tehran's representative in the parliament, stated that Trump has exaggerated the naval economic blockade with the aim of creating fear and cannot sustain it. He added that this action is baseless, contrary to international laws, and will face stronger reactions from the Islamic Republic. Taghipour also said that Trump is looking for an excuse to hide his failures in the war with Iran and Iran's dominance over the Strait of Hormuz.

Nazli Sedghi, a lawyer, stated that the judiciary of the Islamic Republic has become a place for suppressing people. She referred to the December protests and said the transition from the Islamic Republic is led by one leader. Many people in Iran call the name of Prince Reza Pahlavi as a symbol of hope.

Videos show a group of people and families of the martyrs lighting candles at the graves of those killed in January 2026 in Isfahan as part of the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory." This act was to commemorate the victims. Videos of the ceremony have been released.

The dollar rate in Iran has exceeded 235,000 tomans and gasoline prices have risen to 10,000 tomans. Point-to-point inflation in August was 89%, and food inflation exceeded 127%. Prices of oil and rice have increased by more than 300% and 200% respectively, while wages have not yet been adjusted.

Tractor football team will face Shabab Al Ahli UAE in the first week of the Asian Elite League. Tractor lost and was eliminated by this team last season. This news was reported by Farhad Mitra in the Hat-trick program.

Iranians residing in Calgary, Canada, held a march and gathering on the fourth anniversary of Mahsa Amini's death to honor the victims of Iran's uprisings. Participants chanted "Woman, Life, Freedom" and expressed support for Prince Reza Pahlavi. The report was published by Sepidar Valian from Iran International.

Managers of four major AI companies called for slowing down the development of advanced models. Donald Trump opposed this request, emphasizing that the US should not lose its lead over China in AI competition. These managers warned that the pace of technological progress might exceed human control.

Ali Jolani, detained during the December 2025 protests, was released from Bojnord prison on Sunday, September 12, 2026, after posting a five billion toman bail. He is a resident of Jajarm. This news was reported by the HRANA news agency.

A citizen sent a video to Iran International showing aerial images of the dryness of Lake Urmia and the fullness of Lake Van. These two lakes are only about 170 kilometers apart. The citizen compared Lake Urmia to a desert and attributed it to the consequences of the 1979 revolution.

Satellite images show damage to Saudi Arabia's east-west oil pipeline after a drone attack on September 10. Saudi officials stated that oil transport through this pipeline has been temporarily halted. The drone attack is attributed to Iraq.
Mohammad Rafi' Sadeghi, a retired teacher, was arrested by security forces. He was transferred to an unknown location. No further details have been announced.

Rouhollah Rahimpour said Donald Trump's remarks about the end of the war after the US midterm elections do not necessarily mean a peace agreement. He described these remarks as a political and security deadline. Trump believes that continued pressure on the Islamic Republic could lead to a more favorable agreement.

The Instagram page of the restaurant Dastpokht Bibi in Tehran was blocked due to posting a story with Moien's music, accused of publishing criminal content. This action was taken by judicial order. Previously, chef Navab Ebrahimi was arrested for posting a cutlet recipe.

Israel Katz, the Israeli defense minister, announced that the Israeli army controls the Ali al-Taher heights in southern Lebanon. He warned that anyone approaching this area will be destroyed. These statements were made in an interview with an Iran International reporter.

Today, retired telecommunications workers held a protest in Tabriz. They demanded the implementation of regulation 89/24 and attention to supplementary insurance issues. They also expressed their dissatisfaction with the performance of the Imam Executive Headquarters and the Cooperative Company of the IRGC.

Jasem Saavedi, a resident of Hamidiyeh, was arrested by the intelligence forces of Ahvaz and transferred to an unknown location. The arrest took place on Monday, 23 Shahrivar 1405. Harana News Agency reported this news.

A citizen reported the closure of the Khosravi border and confusion among heavy vehicle drivers there. Iranian officials have stated that other Iran-Iraq borders are open. Additionally, increased US sanctions have tightened alternative trade routes for Iran.

On the eve of the fourth anniversary of Mahsa Zhina Amini's death, reports indicate increased pressure for mandatory hijab and the presence of morality police in Isfahan, Rasht, Mashhad, and Nishapur. In Isfahan, morality police vans and buses are detaining women without hijab. Armed forces in Mashhad have also warned women about hijab compliance.

Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmail Baghaei announced that the Austrian chargé d'affaires in Tehran has been summoned. The move followed Austria's failure to issue a visa for Mohammad Eslami, head of Iran's Atomic Energy Organization, to attend the IAEA General Conference in Vienna. Baghaei said Iran knows the decision was taken under US pressure, but this does not diminish Austria's responsibility.

The spokesperson of Tehran Fire Department reported a fire in a pharmacy warehouse on Yusefabad Street. Firefighters controlled the fire after several hours of effort. The incident is now under control.

The Football Federation of the Islamic Republic has filed a complaint against Yashar Soltani for revealing the $20,000 bonus case of the board members. Soltani claimed that indictments have been issued against several senior football federation officials. He also demanded their suspension until the court's verdict is issued.

The Indonesian Search and Rescue Agency released aerial images of a passenger ship that capsized in the Java Sea. At least six people died and 108 were rescued in the incident. 129 people remain missing, and the ship had 243 passengers, including 30 crew members, departing from Surabaya.

Yahya Sari, the military spokesperson for the Houthis, announced a large-scale operation using dozens of drones and ballistic missiles against King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait, Saudi Arabia. This attack was described as a response to Saudi airstrikes on Yemen. Mohammed bin Salman met with the CENTCOM commander to discuss recent regional developments.

Contrary to Iran's international commitments under the Convention on the Rights of the Child, 44 students from Masal county were sent to war zones in western Iran. This deployment was part of the 'Rahian-e Noor' camp. This action violates the section prohibiting the use of children in military activities.

Farhad Mahmoudi, 30 years old, was shot directly in the heart and killed on January 8, 2026, in Mohammadshahr, Karaj. His sister joined the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory" and lit a candle for him, calling him a hero. She said his footsteps are still visible in this land and his memory is an honor.

Manchester City defeated Manchester United with a goal by Erling Haaland in the 60th minute. The goal was initially ruled offside but was accepted after VAR review. The English professional football refereeing body called the VAR decision a mistake and announced it will review the incident.

The UN independent fact-finding mission on Iran called for full adherence to international law and cessation of conflicts. The head of the mission highlighted the devastating human cost of the conflicts. She emphasized that civilians must be protected and all necessary precautions taken to ensure their safety.

The tuition fees at Payame Noor University have doubled in the new semester, affecting students from poor backgrounds. Amid the economic crisis, electricity for shops has been cut off without prior notice, and some factories are laying off workers. People face challenges such as high dental care costs and power outages in various regions.

Hamid Ghanbari, Deputy Foreign Minister, announced that the Ministry of Foreign Affairs is drafting a comprehensive sanctions map. He emphasized that sanctions will continue in the long term and preparations are necessary. He also stated that full readiness for sanctions prevents the opposing side from applying maximum pressure in negotiations.

A group of security and protection staff from Maroon Oil and Gas Company gathered today in front of Khuzestan Governorate in Ahvaz. The protesters complained about delayed salary payments, lack of bonuses and severance, insurance issues, and poor working conditions. This is their second protest, and they have not yet received a response from officials.

The prime ministers of Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland announced that on Monday, 23 Shahrivar, they will sign a memorandum to start the process of independence from the UK. These three pro-independence prime ministers called for the right to hold referendums on separation from the UK. Earlier, Donald Trump had expressed his wish to see a united Ireland.

Between September 2025 and September 2026, at least 135 lawyers in Iran faced judicial and security actions. These actions included arrests, summons, prison sentences, disqualification from practicing law, and travel bans. Five lawyers are currently imprisoned, and 34 others have been detained.

The Mahan Run competition scheduled for October 1 in Kerman was canceled due to the lack of permits. The race was planned for 5, 10, and 21 kilometers. Additionally, the Persian Gulf half marathon in Kish was also canceled before it took place.

Mohammad Parsa Golchin, a University of Tehran student and gold medalist in the literary Olympiad, has been accused of membership in a rebellious group and other security-related charges. He has been summoned to Branch 268 of the Mashhad Prosecutor's Office. He was arrested along with 18 others during a friendly visit.

Benjamin Netanyahu and Yair Lapid held a security meeting in Jerusalem. Netanyahu requested Lapid's support to reinstate the Israeli budget to increase defense funding. Lapid agrees with increasing the army's budget but opposes funding it through higher taxes on the middle class or reservists.

The new season of the Asian Elite Football League is starting, and Esteghlal and Tractor, Iran's representatives, are banned from hosting matches in their home country. Esteghlal is hosting Al Sadd of Qatar but will play at the Basra International Stadium in Iraq. This information comes from an interview with Mohammad Taghavi on Iran International.
The Saharkhizan restaurant in Rasht has been closed. The manager was arrested for "insulting the hijab." Supporters of the government also attacked the restaurant and damaged parts of it.

Abdolnaser Hemmati, the Governor of the Central Bank, stated that external pressures, sanctions, and geopolitical risks are the main factors causing fluctuations in Iran's economy. He emphasized that the Central Bank cannot remain passive against the transmission of external shocks to the domestic economy. Hemmati also highlighted the importance of monetary discipline and preventing budget deficits through increased liquidity.

The US Department of War has released a video showing the moments of bombing of Islamic Republic military forces to rescue one of two American pilots, named operation 'Bravo', in the mountains of Isfahan. The video, after being declassified, was aired for the first time on CBS's '60 Minutes' program.

The head of the Iran-China Chamber of Commerce stated that the cost of shipping a container from China to Iran has increased from three thousand to twelve thousand dollars. Due to disruptions at southern ports, goods are now transported via longer routes. This added cost significantly affects the prices of goods.

Mai Sato, the UN special rapporteur on human rights in Iran, referred to the fourth anniversary of Mahsa Amini's death and said the resistance sparked by this event has not faded. She added that the authorities' response to protests was the use of deadly violence. She also emphasized that the women and girls who took to the streets in Mahsa's name continue to insist on their right to decide about their clothing and lifestyle.

The US dollar price in the free market returned to the range of 235,000 tomans. The official dollar transfer rate also set a new record. Arash Azarmi explained the situation of Iran's currency market.

JD Vance, the US Vice President, stated that the United States has had direct talks with the Houthis. He said the US is in control of the situation and is protecting its interests. The US is also in contact with regional countries and closely monitoring the situation.

One of the rescued pilots of the American F-15 fighter jet revealed that the US deployed 92 elite soldiers in Iran for the first time in 46 years. This operation occurred after the IRGC was thwarted by a CIA deception. The information was disclosed in an interview with CBS.

Donald Trump stated that Ukraine and Russia have agreed not to target each other's energy facilities. He also said that the global increase in diesel prices is mainly due to the Russia-Ukraine war, not Iran.

The daughter of missing person Hossein Naseri joined the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory." She lit a candle for her father and other victims of January 2026 whose bodies were found at Al-Ghadir Hospital in Tehran. This act was done in memory of the victims.

Molavi Yousef Gorgij, a Sunni cleric and imam of the Mohammad Rasool Allah Mosque in Zahedan, was killed in a shooting outside his home. He was a supporter of the Islamic Republic and played a significant role in government meetings. The cleric died from severe injuries after being targeted by unknown armed individuals.
